page.layout: One printed page: title page, centred text block with a woodcut vignette (tree and figure, banner "NON SOLUS") between the text and the imprint; no margins with text. The digitiser's banner at the foot and the handwritten "4" at top left are not transcribed.

main_text.l: SS. THEOL. DOCT. ET IN ACAD. LVGD.
Amplissimi Senatûs Academici Consensu, & Celeberrimæ Facultatis THEOLOGICÆ Decreto,
Summisque in THEOLOGIA Honoribus, & Privilegiis, ritè, ac legitimè consequendis,
Ad diem 2. Octob. à puncto horæ 9 ad 11.

page.notes: The woodcut vignette shows a tree with a banner reading "NON SOLUS" and a standing figure; no text beyond the banner. The handwritten "4" at top left and the digitiser's credit lines at the foot are omitted.
